question: Can standard jet-separation / Reider-Beltrametti-Sommese / equigeneric transversality machinery dispose the fixed-V6 D0 or Gamma solely from the retained intersection and normalization-defect data, without first extracting the missing singularity support?

source_locks.ambient: S0 is smooth and q:S0->Q=C2xC2 is finite etale of degree 4; g(C2)=2

external_references.name: Dedieu-Sernesi, Equigeneric and equisingular families of curves on surfaces
external_references.exact_use: For a reduced planar singularity the local delta-constant/equigeneric stratum has codimension delta in a semiuniversal deformation; global equigeneric transversality is a separate issue.

external_references.name: Keilen, Smoothness of Equisingular Families of Curves
external_references.exact_use: Reider-Bogomolov style sufficient conditions for T-smoothness on smooth projective surfaces/products of curves depend on positivity plus local singularity schemes/invariants.

external_references.name: Terakawa, The d-very ampleness on a projective surface in positive characteristic
external_references.exact_use: Beltrametti-Sommese/Reider-type d-very ampleness criterion for an adjoint K+N uses N nef and the numerical threshold N^2 >= 4d+5; used here only as a generic jet-separation capacity benchmark.

S0_etale_degree4.derivation: finite etale degree 4 multiplies K^2 and chi(O) by 4

conditional_if_N0_ample.interpretation: If the global linear system is transverse to the local delta-constant strata, codimension delta exceeds |D0| by 236..264 and the hypothetical member is impossible.

conditional_if_NQ_ample.interpretation: If the global correspondence linear system is transverse to the local delta-constant strata, codimension delta exceeds |Gamma| by 239..267 and the hypothetical correspondence is impossible.

preflight_result.new_exact_pattern: Both upstairs and downstairs have a conditional negative expected-dimension gap: the retained delta defect is larger than the Riemann-Roch linear-system dimension by roughly 2.4e2 conditions once suitable adjoint vanishing and equigeneric transversality are available.
preflight_result.reason: The standard Reider/Beltrametti-Sommese all-zero-dimensional-schemes threshold N^2>=4k+5 is far below the k=delta-1 range required to force arbitrary conductor/equigeneric schemes. Seshadri/jet refinements also require local support/multiplicity or positivity data not present in the retained package.
preflight_result.reopen_condition: Supply a source-bound proof of N0=D0-K_S0 or NQ=Gamma-K_Q positivity together with a transversality/H1-vanishing theorem for the actual conductor/equigeneric zero-dimensional scheme that does not require full arbitrary k-very ampleness; alternatively extract singularity types/support strongly enough to satisfy a sharper Keilen/GLS-type criterion.

next_route_rationale: Symmetric differentials are materially distinct and can attack the low normalization genus relative to the two high-degree maps/common-cover geometry without requiring prior reconstruction of the singularity support. Actual V6 section materialization remains preserved but overlaps the dedicated EX2 reconstruction lane.

cycle_exit.CYCLE_ACTIVE_RECEIVER: equigeneric transversality strong enough to turn the 236..267 conditional expected-dimension deficit into an actual nonexistence result
cycle_exit.CYCLE_NEW_VIEW: Use symmetric differentials/low-genus constraints on the normalization and its two maps instead of trying to separate the full conductor scheme by generic jets.
